text:
Lisa (Product): quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Q3 "sprint lattice" initiative by EOD Thu. Customer A wants deterministic <=120ms tail for 95th. can we map owners + blockers?
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): noted. is 120ms for end-to-end inference or just token generation?
Lisa (Product): end-to-end from api gateway to response. includes reranking path.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): ok. runtime needs a kernel change for condensed KV eviction + prefix caching to hit that at scale. estimates: 2w eng + 1w perf.
Marco (Eng-Infra): infra implications: to hit 120ms under peak we need prewarmed burst pools in two regions, and a new capacity slot for canary. capacity ask: +8 GPUs initial.
Sasha (Security): KMS/HSM key rotation for customer keys is required for Private customers — that adds integration testing and an HSM cert review. timeline ~1w, dependency on infra networking.
Kim (Eng): for product gating — do we need full A/B or is canary + synthetic checks enough?
Lisa (Product): canary + synthetic checks are fine for the first roll, but we need spelled-out launch criteria: perf SLOs, regression test suite, and a rollback plan.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): adding a quick rollout policy snippet for discussion:
```
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  metrics:
    - p95_latency < 120ms
    - error_rate < 0.5%
  fallback: route-to-stable
```
Marco (Eng-Infra): infrastructure checklist: networking CIDR review, prewarm runbook, autoscale policy tweak, capacity pin (reserved) for week 0. I'll attach slot counts after this thread.
devex-bot: reminder — prev engineering sync has release blackout windows next Tue 00:00-06:00 UTC.
Sasha (Security): threat-model note: reranker pulls embeddings from shared cache; need to ensure token redaction and access controls. will schedule 30m review.
Lisa (Product): owners suggestion: Ajay runtime (owner), Marco infra (owner), Sasha security (owner), Kim QA/acceptance. anyone disagree?
Kim (Eng): fine from QA side. will prepare synthetic suites + golden prompts. need 2 days to build.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): runtime asks: can product relax 95th -> 150ms for initial beta? that would reduce infra pressure.
Lisa (Product): customers insisted on 120ms but we can offer "beta" tier with 150ms and call out "enterprise" with 120ms SLA. want minimal scope to ship.
Marco (Eng-Infra): if we do 150ms for beta, we can reduce to +4 GPUs and simpler routing. wins cost.
Sasha (Security): security sign-off still required either way. 150ms doesn't change the KMS/privilege matrix.
Lisa (Product): decision: beta tier 150ms SLA, enterprise 120ms target with reserved capacity. next steps: 1) Ajay: produce perf PR + benchmark plan by Tue EOD. 2) Marco: capacity layout + canary runbook by Wed noon. 3) Sasha: threat-model doc + test matrix by Wed EOD. 4) Kim: synthetic suite ready by Wed EOD.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): ack. I'll post perf run results in #eng-runtime and link here.
Marco (Eng-Infra): ack, will drop numbers and prewarm runbook.
Sasha (Security): ack, will DM for HSM cert details.
Lisa (Product): thanks all — I'll compile acceptance checklist and ping execs after we have the three artifacts. :thumbsup:
Kim (Eng): :eyes: will do regression baseline.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): one more ask — need a short SLA blurb for docs. Lisa can you draft?
Lisa (Product): yes, will draft and share by Tue morning.
devex-bot: agenda item created: "sprint-lattice gating review" Thu 16:00 UTC — invites sent.
